label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
Beth,

Can you just hold off before writing Tenby off completely? I’m not having a go, and I’m not taking sides over Lowri’s 40th in November. I know it kicked off over what was said about her ex, and things were said on both sides. I do think Lowri’s sorry really, underneath her acting all cold. But you’re both as stubborn as each other, and I say that with love.

Nia rang me crying last week asking if you were still coming. She doesn’t know you’ve pulled out, and I haven’t told her. You sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019. She hasn’t forgotten that. You’re doing a reading at her wedding on 17 April at Margam — you’re one of her people, not just somebody filling a space in a cottage.

I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get the hen weekend off, and it cost me a night stop I really wanted. I’m not saying that to guilt-trip you, just that I did it because being there for Nia matters.

So could we make this as easy as possible? Don’t come Friday if you don’t want to. Just come Saturday for the meal. Get the train from Cardiff Central — it’s roughly two and a half hours — and you only need to be in Tenby for about six. I’ll pick you up from the station and you can kip in with me Saturday night. I’ve got the twin room, so you’ll have your own bed and it’s honestly no bother.

I honestly think you’d regret missing it, and Nia’s going to remember this weekend and who wasn’t there. I’d hate that for both of you. You wouldn’t have to pretend nothing happened or put everything right with Lowri in one night. Just come for Nia.

And don’t send Lowri the £85 yet. Leave the money for now and let’s see where we are.

Will you think about Saturday? I’ll do the picking up, the room’s sorted, and I’ll be right there with you.

Siân xx
